raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00), so every row in it is duplicated with identical content. The txn_id range 900001–904975 has exactly 4975 distinct values, which matches one logical row per txn_id. The fix is to dedupe silver_transactions on txn_id; the gold tables rebuild correctly from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
